comments.text: Kazakhstan has everything to become one of the world's top travel destinations—stunning landscapes, rich history, and unique culture. The only thing it's missing is the global attention it truly deserves

replies.author: @MeridianQuest
replies.text: @OrionHidden I agree, except that others feel the same way when they temporarily change their surroundings and discover new places and cultures... so everything is relative. Tastes, colors, and smells are probably not open to debate. Do you agree?

replies.author: @OrionHidden
replies.text: I like the sentiment, but I don't think everyone dreams of traveling. For some people, simply having peace, health, or their family together is a much bigger dream than seeing beautiful places.
